// This is the reachability witness for the production deadcode pass. It is
// materialized as a throwaway main next to the module and never compiled as part
// of it, so the library keeps having no main package.
//
// Every exported function of every production package has to be REACHED from
// here, otherwise the strict production pass reports it as dead.
//
// Two different idioms are needed, and the difference is not cosmetic. A METHOD
// value (`_ = value.Method`) marks the method as address-taken and counts as
// reachable. A plain FUNCTION value assigned to the blank identifier does NOT:
// the reference is discarded before the reachability analysis sees a call, so
// every package-level function has to actually be CALLED here. Calls are chosen
// to be side-effect free — refusals, empty inputs, nil seams — because this
// witness is compiled, not run.
package main

import (
	"context"

	"github.com/AtomiCloud/diene.go-e2e/adapters/filesystem"
	"github.com/AtomiCloud/diene.go-e2e/adapters/process"
	"github.com/AtomiCloud/diene.go-e2e/lib/e2e"
	"github.com/AtomiCloud/diene.go-e2e/lib/fixture"
	"github.com/AtomiCloud/diene.go-e2e/lib/preview"
	"github.com/AtomiCloud/diene.go-e2e/testhelper"
	"github.com/AtomiCloud/diene.go-errors-problems/lib/problem"
)

func main() {
	ctx := context.Background()

	// --- lib/e2e -----------------------------------------------------------
	problems, _ := e2e.NewProblems(problem.LocalErrorPortal())
	_ = e2e.ProblemTypes()
	_ = problems.Registry
	_, _ = problems.Catalog()
	_ = problems.Raise
	_ = problems.RaiseFrom
	result := e2e.Result{ExitCode: 0}
	_ = result.Succeeded()
	step := e2e.Step{Name: "step", Invocation: e2e.Invocation{}, Expect: e2e.Expectation{}}
	_ = e2e.CheckStep(step, result)
	mismatch := &e2e.StepMismatchError{Step: "step", Reason: "reason"}
	_ = mismatch.Error()
	journey := e2e.Journey{Name: "journey", Steps: []e2e.Step{step}}
	report := e2e.Report{Driver: "driver", Journey: "journey", Steps: []e2e.StepReport{{Name: "step", Result: result}}}
	_ = e2e.CompareReports(report, report, problems)

	terminal := process.NewTerminal(process.TerminalOptions{})
	_ = process.Environ(nil, nil)
	_ = terminal.Run

	compiled, _ := e2e.NewCompiledDriver(e2e.CompiledOptions{
		Artifact: "/bin/true", Terminal: terminal, Problems: problems,
	})
	_ = compiled.Name
	_ = compiled.Artifact
	_ = compiled.Run

	entrypoint := e2e.Entrypoint(testhelper.EchoEntrypoint)
	inProcess, _ := e2e.NewInProcessDriver(e2e.InProcessOptions{Entrypoint: entrypoint, Problems: problems})
	_ = inProcess.Name
	_ = inProcess.Run
	_, _ = e2e.RunJourney(ctx, inProcess, journey, problems)
	_, _, _ = e2e.RunParity(ctx, inProcess, inProcess, journey, problems)

	// --- adapters/filesystem ----------------------------------------------
	vfs := filesystem.NewVfs()
	_ = vfs.Exists
	_ = vfs.ReadBytes
	_ = vfs.ReadText
	_ = vfs.WriteBytes
	_ = vfs.WriteText
	_ = vfs.List
	_ = vfs.CreateDirectory
	_ = vfs.Delete

	// --- lib/preview -------------------------------------------------------
	// A real (empty) environment seam, so the environment reader and its default
	// handling are reached rather than short-circuited by a nil-seam refusal.
	system := testhelper.NewInMemorySystem(testhelper.InMemorySystemOptions{})
	_, _ = preview.Resolve(system, problems)
	_ = preview.Schema()
	_ = preview.EngineBlocks()
	_ = preview.APIBlock()
	target := preview.Target{Landscape: "garden"}
	_ = target.Validate
	_ = target.Identity
	_ = target.AppBlock
	_ = target.OtelConfig
	_ = target.AuthConfig
	_ = target.APIConfig
	unconfigured := &preview.UnconfiguredError{Component: "problems"}
	_ = unconfigured.Error()

	// --- lib/fixture -------------------------------------------------------
	builder := fixture.NewBuilder(problems)
	_ = builder.WithApp
	_ = builder.WithBlock
	_ = builder.WithOverlay
	_ = builder.WithEnv
	_ = builder.WithList
	_ = builder.WithSecret
	bundle, _ := builder.Build()
	_ = bundle.Landscapes()
	_ = bundle.Merged("garden")
	_, _ = bundle.Document("garden")
	_ = bundle.Environ("")
	_ = fixture.EnvKey("ATOMI_", "app.version")
	_ = bundle.Materialize
	_ = bundle.Loader
	_, _ = fixture.Instant(system)
	_, _ = fixture.Duration("PT1S")
	_, _ = fixture.Zone("UTC")
	_ = fixture.Directory("/tmp", "case")
	unrenderable := &fixture.UnrenderableError{Reason: "reason"}
	_ = unrenderable.Error()

	// --- testhelper --------------------------------------------------------
	observer := quiet{}
	_, _ = testhelper.SampleProblems()
	_ = testhelper.CheckResult(result, e2e.Expectation{})
	testhelper.AssertResult(observer, result, e2e.Expectation{})
	_ = testhelper.CheckStep(step, result)
	testhelper.AssertStep(observer, step, result)
	_ = testhelper.CheckReport(report, journey)
	testhelper.AssertReport(observer, report, journey)
	_, _ = testhelper.CheckHarnessProblem(nil, "id")
	_ = testhelper.AssertHarnessProblem(observer, nil, "id")
	testhelper.AssertNoHarnessProblem(observer, nil)
	_ = testhelper.RequireReport(observer, report, nil)
	scripted := testhelper.NewScriptedDriver("scripted")
	_ = scripted.Name
	_ = scripted.Run
	_ = scripted.Calls
	_ = scripted.Remaining
	_ = testhelper.EchoEntrypoint
	_, _ = testhelper.NewEchoDriver(problems)
	stack, _ := testhelper.StartStack(ctx, testhelper.StackOptions{})
	_ = testhelper.RequireStack(observer, stack, nil)
	_ = testhelper.PresetRequireEntry(observer, map[string]int{}, "key")
	_ = testhelper.PresetRequireStarted(observer, (*int)(nil), nil)
	_ = stack.Blocks
	_ = stack.Terminate
}

// quiet satisfies the TestHelper's assertion interface without ending anything.
// The witness is compiled, never run, so a reported failure has nowhere to go.
type quiet struct{}

// Helper is a no-op.
func (quiet) Helper() {}

// Fatalf is a no-op.
func (quiet) Fatalf(string, ...any) {}
